name: model-router
description: Routes each subagent to a Claude model and effort that fits its task, judged by Jev or the decision model the provider option names. For each routed Agent call it sends the task text, condensed to at most 12,000 characters, the agent's description, cut to 500 characters, and the call's one-line description, all with token-shaped strings such as keys masked, to the provider's own API (api.typesafe.ai, api.openai.com or generativelanguage.googleapis.com), to openrouter.ai or to both, as its provider and gateway options allow, each with its own key. The built-in general-purpose and claude agents send a fixed text in place of their description. The scope option picks the calls: core routes the four built-in agents, extended also routes user, project and plugin agents and sends their text. A config tool opens the plugin's own dialog to change the provider, gateway and scope options. A key set as an environment variable is visible to every process Claude Code starts.

provider.description: Shows or changes whose model scores subagent calls: typesafe, openai, google.
provider.content: Call the tool mcp__model-router__config. With no setting it shows the router's settings. With the setting "provider" it asks the person whose model should score subagent calls and applies the answer. Pass no value, because the person chooses in the dialog. Show the tool's reply to the person. If the tool is missing, tell the person to open /config, find the model-router plugin, and set its provider option in the plugin's settings.

gateway.description: Shows or changes how OpenRouter is used for the provider: direct, auto, openrouter-first, openrouter.
gateway.content: Call the tool mcp__model-router__config. With no setting it shows the router's settings. With the setting "gateway" it asks the person how OpenRouter should be used for the provider and applies the answer. Pass no value, because the person chooses in the dialog. Show the tool's reply to the person. If the tool is missing, tell the person to open /config, find the model-router plugin, and set its gateway option in the plugin's settings.

scope.description: Shows or changes which agent calls the router routes: core, extended.
scope.content: Call the tool mcp__model-router__config. With no setting it shows the router's settings. With the setting "scope" it asks the person which agent calls the router should route and applies the answer. Pass no value, because the person chooses in the dialog. Show the tool's reply to the person. If the tool is missing, tell the person to open /config, find the model-router plugin, and set its scope option in the plugin's settings.

provider.title: Scoring provider
provider.description: Whose model scores each subagent task: typesafe, openai or google.

gateway.title: OpenRouter gateway
gateway.description: How the provider is reached: direct (its own API only), auto (its own API, then OpenRouter), openrouter-first (OpenRouter, then its own API) or openrouter (OpenRouter only).

scope.title: Routing scope
scope.description: Which subagents are routed: core (the default agents only) or extended (also other agents, as the README lists).

models.title: Scoring models
models.description: The scoring model per provider as provider:model entries for typesafe, openai or google, such as {typesafe:jev-latest, openai:gpt-6-luna}; a provider with no entry uses its default.

model.title: Jev model
model.description: Removed: the setup skill moves it into models.

api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
api_key.description: The plugin sends it to TypeSafe when provider is typesafe and gateway is not openrouter.

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key
openai_api_key.description: The plugin sends it to OpenAI when provider is openai and gateway is not openrouter.

google_api_key.title: Google API key
google_api_key.description: The plugin sends it to Google when provider is google and gateway is not openrouter.

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouter_api_key.description: The plugin sends it to OpenRouter when gateway is not direct.
